title_fil: Mabisang Gawi sa Lugar ng Trabaho
title_en: Efficient and Sustainable Practices at Work
objectives_fil: Matutukoy ang nasasayang na tubig, kuryente, supplies o oras sa isang gawain.
Maipapakita ang ligtas na pagtitipid at maihihiwalay ito sa nakapipinsalang pagbabawas.
Makapagmumungkahi at makapagpapaliwanag ng routine na may responsable at malinaw na paraan.
Makapaghahambing ng resulta bago at matapos ang pagbabago, kasama ang kalidad ng serbisyo.
objectives_en: Identify wasted water, electricity, supplies or time in a task.
Demonstrate safe conservation and distinguish it from harmful cuts.
Propose and explain a routine with an owner and a clear method.
Compare results before and after a change, including service quality.
summary_fil: Ang problema ni Elena ay hindi nalutas sa basta pagbabawas ng gamit. Natukoy ang tagas, maling printout at oras ng paghahanap; bawat isa ay may ligtas na katapat na pagbabago. Nanatili ang tubig para sa hand hygiene at ang tamang single-use rules. Ang routine ay may may-ari at kapalit, at ang resulta ay sinusuri kasama ang kalidad at workload. Nagtatagal ang pagtitipid kapag napapanatili rin ang serbisyong kailangan ng tao.
summary_en: Elena’s problem was not solved by simply cutting supplies. Leaks, incorrect printouts and searching time each led to a safer change. Water for hand hygiene and clinical single-use rules remained protected. The routine had an owner and a replacement, and results were reviewed alongside quality and workload. Conservation lasts when it also preserves the services people need.
